chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Divorce occurs when he says to her, 'Observe the waiting period,' or when he says to her, 'You are divorced.'
ai.seo_question: What specific words constitute a valid divorce in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar clarifies the mechanism of *talaq al-kinayah* (figurative divorce) by identifying 'i'tadi' (observe the waiting period) and 'anti taliq' (you are divorced) as explicit indicators of intent. It highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on the husband's declaration as the primary trigger for the commencement of the *iddah* (waiting period), distinguishing it from other forms of marital dissolution.
